patch_description:
This implementation combines a moderate differential-evolution global search with an elite oriented-matroid cell refinement portfolio. Rather than polishing only one global-search endpoint, it extracts several distinct elite population members, fixes the determinant signs for each candidate cell, and solves a signed epigraph maximin program from each one.

The key idea is that once determinant orientations are fixed, the absolute-area maximin problem becomes a smoother constrained optimization problem. Maintaining multiple elite cells reduces the risk that the nominal differential-evolution winner lies in a locally inferior active-constraint pattern. A deterministic annealing fallback remains available when SciPy is unavailable or optimization fails.
